# BrowserProbe

> BrowserProbe is a free browser-diagnostics website that reports what the current browser exposes through standard web APIs. Results describe the current session and should not be treated as verified physical-device identity, proof of fingerprint uniqueness, or a guarantee of anonymity.

## Main pages

- [Browser diagnostic report](https://browserprobe.app/): Run the complete browser inspection and review its evidence, confidence labels, and limitations.
- [About the methodology](https://browserprobe.app/about): Learn how BrowserProbe separates observed browser values from interpretations.
- [Privacy policy](https://browserprobe.app/privacy-policy): Review local processing, network requests, third-party monetization code, and report-storage practices.
- [Browser privacy guides](https://browserprobe.app/blog): Read explanatory articles about browser fingerprinting and privacy signals.

## Identity and network tools

- [What Is My Browser?](https://browserprobe.app/tools/what-is-my-browser): Browser name, version, engine, platform hints, and user agent.
- [What Is My IP Address?](https://browserprobe.app/tools/what-is-my-ip): Public request address and IP-family interpretation.
- [Timezone and Locale](https://browserprobe.app/tools/timezone-locale): Timezone, offset, locale, and browser language preferences.
- [WebRTC Address Test](https://browserprobe.app/tools/webrtc-leak-test): ICE candidates with public-IP comparison and explicit limitations.

## Privacy and fingerprinting tools

- [Cookies Test](https://browserprobe.app/tools/cookies-test): First-party cookie and web-storage availability.
- [Canvas Fingerprint Test](https://browserprobe.app/tools/canvas-fingerprint): A repeatable identifier for one canvas rendering sample.
- [Audio Fingerprint Test](https://browserprobe.app/tools/audio-fingerprint): A repeatable identifier for one Web Audio rendering sample.
- [Font Detection](https://browserprobe.app/tools/font-detection): Font names distinguishable through text-metric comparisons.
- [Do Not Track Test](https://browserprobe.app/tools/do-not-track): DNT and Global Privacy Control signals.

## Hardware and feature tools

- [Screen Resolution Test](https://browserprobe.app/tools/screen-resolution): Screen, viewport, color depth, pixel ratio, and touch support.
- [WebGL Information](https://browserprobe.app/tools/webgl-info): WebGL support, renderer strings, limits, and extensions.
- [Hardware Information](https://browserprobe.app/tools/hardware-info): Browser-exposed concurrency, memory, GPU, touch, and battery hints.
- [Media Devices Detection](https://browserprobe.app/tools/media-devices): Permission-limited media-device counts and labels.
- [JavaScript Detection](https://browserprobe.app/tools/javascript-info): JavaScript runtime and selected platform capabilities.
- [Browser Features Support](https://browserprobe.app/tools/browser-features): Availability of selected modern web APIs.

## Project

- [Source code](https://github.com/aamanbhagat/browserprob): Inspect the implementation and detection methodology.
